recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-6205 unless a future work-group issue asks to change the broader Questionnaire note or the current role of Questionnaire.name/code.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Questionnaire issue reporting that the note "Questionnaires may be used to represent predefined forms, named using Questionnaire.name" referred to a missing or incorrect element, with resolution text suggesting Questionnaire.code might be intended.
initial_application: Jira comments cite svn revision 5625. Local git history maps that to deed96053d4689b86b6c3470bb48b68fd6d61244, which changed source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml from Questionnaire.name to Questionnaire.group.title.
additional_context: Later Questionnaire commits changed the same note through Questionnaire.group.concept and then, after the #8986 Group/Question item refactor, to the current item-based wording. Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Questionnaire.name and Questionnaire.code exist as legitimate separate metadata/coding elements, but the old note no longer refers to either as the way predefined forms are named. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the original missing-element reference was explicitly corrected in 2015 and current active source now says predefined forms or panels are referenced using items of type "group".
